Seed Rush

Fill in the verse. 60 seconds. Once a day.

About Seed Rush

Seed Rush is a free daily game built on Bible verses about money, work and stewardship. Each round gives you one minute to fill in the missing words of as many verses as you can, and everyone plays the same verses that day.

Easy asks you to pick one missing word from three. Medium asks you to place three missing words from six. Hard asks you to type all three yourself. A new round starts every day at 7:00 AM Eastern.
